mechanismInference.minimalForm: For each divisor sweep, track a generic saturating multiplicity class so exponent-1, exponent-2 and exponent-3-or-more events are distinguishable, while preserving an independent accumulator.
mechanismInference.antiLeakage: No CUBEFREE, SQUAREFREE, MOBIUS, OEIS identifier, or target-specific primitive may appear in the grammar.
